header: AI MODELS USED IN THIS APP — quick reference (I keep this here because this is the shared AI-services module; if any of the below ever changes, update this block so it never goes stale)

(Updated 7 Nov 2026: Groq is no longer the default anywhere. The one place that talks to Gemini for text is src/lib/ai/geminiChat.ts: timeout, thinking budget, finishReason check, key in a header, safe errors.)
1. Executive Deep Synthesis (search feature's answer-synthesis step) File: src/lib/search/executiveSynthesis.ts -> geminiGenerate()
- Model: GEMINI_SYNTHESIS_MODEL (default gemini-3.1-pro-preview), then gemini-pro-latest, gemini-3.8-flash
- JSON mode, temperature 0.1, thinking "low" (GEMINI_SYNTHESIS_THINKING to change), 52 s total deadline

2. generateChatResponse (this file, below) and the NL2SQL model (src/lib/nl2sql/llm.ts: chatLlm) -- used by the employee/department question engine, the intent classifier and the holiday extraction code
- Provider: Gemini when GEMINI_API_KEY exists (LLM_PROVIDER=gemini|groq forces a choice); Groq only when it is the only key present or LLM_PROVIDER=groq
- Model: GEMINI_CHAT_MODEL (default gemini-3.8-flash), then gemini-flash-latest; thinking "low"
- Local-dev fallback: Ollama, model "llama3.1", when AI_ENVIRONMENT is not "cloud"
- Provider: Google Gemini, model gemini-embedding-001, 768 dimensions (outputDimensionality)

- Stored text (circular chunks, circulars, announcements, holiday policy chunks) = RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT; only questions = RETRIEVAL_QUERY. (text-embedding-004, named here before, no longer exists for this key.)
